sentences.en: The food chain in the ocean is very complex and fragile.
sentences.zh: 海洋里的食物链非常复杂且脆弱。

sentences.en: When a predator dies, it affects the entire food chain.
sentences.zh: 当一个掠食者死亡时，整个食物链都会受到影响。

sentences.en: Climate change can disrupt the delicate balance of a food chain.
sentences.zh: 气候变化会破坏食物链的微妙平衡。
